method: Adult single fares from each operator's NeTEx fares data on the Bus Open Data Service: for each route and direction, the fare stages (groups of stops) and the price between every pair. Only tables with a stop in the map area are kept; where a route and direction is published more than once, the one valid latest.
caveats: These are the operators' published on-bus prices. App, contactless and m-ticket fares can be lower, and are not published here.
England's national fare cap applies on top: the site never quotes a single above the cap in data/ticket_zones.json.
A fare applies between fare stages, not stops. A stop the operator has not placed in a stage has no published fare, and the site falls back to the cap for it.
